# Trump’s Approval Rating Deep Underwater on All Issues for First Time: Poll

Published

Aug 27, 2026 at 05:39 AM EDT

Sam Stevenson

Associate News Editor

President Donald Trump's approval rating has slipped deep below water on every issue measured by an independent monthly tracker poll for the first time in the survey's history. [...] The broader mood is grim. A 52 percent majority of adults say things are going poorly and that major, disruptive changes are needed, up from 49 percent in July. Just 7 percent say the country is going well.

The pessimism cuts across party lines: 82 percent of Democrats, 53 percent of independents and even 21 percent of Republicans say things are going poorl

results.content: A big component of Trump's increase in net job approval over the past week is a rise in support from Independents, who rose from a net approval of -53 last week to -38 this week. But polling results for Independents can be particularly volatile, and Independents' approval of Trump remains in the range of his numbers with the group in recent months. [...] Donald Trump's popularity rebounded slightly in this week's Economist / YouGov Poll after his recent slump, but he remains deeply unpopular. This week's poll finds that 36% of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, and 57% disapprove — a net job approval of -21. That's an improvement for Trump from the week before

results.content:
Republicans across the state appear to have been weighed down this August by a midterm election while President Donald Trump’s approval rating sits 20 points underwater.

A swing of a few points is a big deal in races across the Cascades where Republicans are struggling to hold onto seats in historically competitive areas – but in relatively red Spokane County, conservatives in most races are still commanding solid leads over their progressive counterparts.
